questions.stem: 老師兩年來一直用 3D 印表機，為那些覺得科學概念抽象的學生做模型。
questions.answer: For two years, teachers have been using 3D printers to make models for those who find scientific concepts abstract.
accepted_answers: For the past two years, teachers have been using 3D printers to create models for students who find scientific concepts abstract.
In the past two years, teachers have been using 3D printers to build models for those students who think scientific concepts are too abstract.

questions.stem: 親眼看到自己的設計變成模型，學生們對科學越來越有興趣。
questions.answer: Seeing their own designs turn into models, students are becoming more and more interested in science.
accepted_answers: Watching their own designs become models, students have become more and more interested in science.
Having seen their own designs turned into models, the students are growing more and more interested in science.

1.explanation_zh: 「兩年來一直用」是從兩年前持續到現在、而且還在進行，用現在完成進行式 have been using，時間寫 for two years（或 for the past two years）。「為那些…的學生做模型」中文把長修飾語放在名詞前面，英文改成 for those who …（those who＝…的人），who 子句說明是哪些人：those who find scientific concepts abstract（find + 受詞 + 形容詞＝覺得某事…）。「用 3D 印表機做模型」：use 3D printers to make models，不定詞表示用途。
evidence: 為那些覺得科學概念抽象的學生做模型
1.strategy_zh: 「…來一直…」想 have been + V-ing + for／since；「那些…的人」先想 those who …。
hints: 切成四段：老師兩年來一直用／3D 印表機／為那些覺得科學概念抽象的學生／做模型
標的詞彙：printer（印表機）、model（模型）、scientific（科學的）、concept（概念）、abstract（抽象的）
句型框架：For + 時間, S + have been + V-ing … to VR … for those who + V …

2.explanation_zh: 前半句「親眼看到自己的設計變成模型」沒有主詞，動作者就是後面的「學生們」，英文可以改成分詞構句 Seeing their own designs turn into models,（see + 受詞 + 原形動詞＝看到…變成…）；主要子句一定要以 students 當主詞，否則會變成懸垂分詞。「越來越有興趣」用 more and more interested，描述正在發生的變化可用 are becoming／are growing；人感到興趣用 interested in。
evidence: 親眼看到自己的設計變成模型
2.strategy_zh: 兩個動作共用一個主詞、中間沒有連接詞時，可以把前一個動作改成 V-ing 分詞構句；「越來越…」想 more and more + adj.（或比較級 and 比較級）。
hints: 切成四段：親眼看到自己的設計／變成模型／學生們／對科學越來越有興趣
標的詞彙：see（看到）、design（設計）、model（模型）、student（學生）、interested（感興趣的）、science（科學）
句型框架：V-ing + O …, S + be becoming + more and more + adj. + in …

1.translation: For two years, the teacher has been using a 3D printer to make models for those students who find scientific concepts abstract.
1.explanation_zh: 「兩年來一直」用 for two years 加現在完成進行式；「那些覺得…的學生」用 those students who；「覺得科學概念抽象」用 find + 受詞 + 形容詞。

2.translation: Seeing their own designs turn into models with their own eyes, the students have become more and more interested in science.
2.explanation_zh: 「親眼看到…，學生們…」用分詞構句 Seeing…，邏輯主詞是 the students；「看到設計變成模型」用感官動詞 see + O + 原形動詞；「越來越有興趣」用 more and more interested，配現在完成式表逐漸改變。own 出現兩次稍嫌重複，所以信心給 medium。

issues_zh: 中文「老師兩年來一直用 3D 印表機」的「老師」沒有標示單複數，讀成一位特定的老師（the teacher has been using a 3D printer）至少和泛指的 teachers 一樣自然（第 2 句又接「學生們」，像在描述某一班的情形）；但三個參考譯文和第 1 部分的 accepted 全部只收複數 teachers have been using，我的盲譯 For two years, the teacher has been using … 因此落在可接受寫法外。
建議第 1 部分 accepted 補 For two years, the teacher has been using／A teacher has been using …，並至少一個參考譯文改用單數；或把中文改成「老師們」以消除歧義。

「親眼」三個參考譯文和第 1 部分 accepted 都沒有譯出（只寫 Seeing／Watching）；建議至少一個參考譯文與 accepted 補上 with their own eyes／firsthand（例如 Seeing their own designs turn into models with their own eyes, …），免得評分時把譯出「親眼」的學生當成多寫，或讓人以為漏譯也不扣分。
